audit.why: Jayce owns levels 1-3 and level 6 on range; Poppy owns 4-5 and everything from first item once she can stick to him. 56.63% over 897 games with a tricky 7.5/10 fits — the difficulty is the poke phase, not the outcome.

audit.whatIsWrong: The first three chart rows disagreed with the packet AND with the page's own text. Level 1 read Jayce while whys[0] describes a wash; Level 2 read Skill and Level 3 read Poppy while whys[1] says he 'pokes you out before your Q+E wall-stun is reliable', whys[2] says 'his ranged chip outpaces your flat early damage', and spikes[0] is literally titled 'Jayce poke window' for levels 2-3.
audit.why: Three independent parts of the page all describe Jayce owning levels 2 and 3, and the packet chart agrees. Only the side tokens said otherwise.
audit.corrected: phases[0,1,2].side and win[0,1,2] flipped as one group to Skill / Jayce / Jayce, rated 5/10, 3/10, 3/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Jayce's stances are scrambled across seven fields. 'Hammer Q acceleration-gate' appears four times — Acceleration Gate is the CANNON E, and the hammer Q is To the Skies!, a leap. 'Cannon E knockback' appears three times — the knockback is Thundering Blow, the HAMMER E; the cannon E is the gate and knocks back nothing.
audit.why: Riot's text splits every slot by stance and the page mixed them, so a player is told to bait a knockback out of the ability that has none, and to fear a gate on the slot that cannot cast it. The packet's defect note already flagged that none of Jayce's abilities were named correctly.
audit.corrected: Every occurrence rewritten to the real stance pairing: Shock Blast and Acceleration Gate as the poke, To the Skies! as the leap your W stops, Thundering Blow as the knockback to bait.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere; Shock Blast was described only as 'His main poke. Dodge it.'
audit.why: Shock Blast is 16/14/12/10/8/6s and Thundering Blow is 20/18/16/14/12/10s — those six ranks are what make the punish window countable. The weapon swap is 6s, which is why he is never locked out of a bar for long.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d, phases[1].why, mid, tradeGood and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: All three don'ts carried boilerplate bodies unrelated to their titles ('Walk into his Q-gate', 'Get E-knocked', 'Let the poke war drag').
audit.why: The real content is the gate empowering Shock Blast's speed, range and damage; Thundering Blow throwing you out of your own 475 E range; and Poppy having no ranged answer at all.
audit.corrected: All three bodies rewritten to their headings.

notes: Corroborating the mirror agent from this side: the jayce__poppy audit found that Poppy's Steadfast Presence passive raises her Armor and MR as her health falls, so Jayce's 'poke her low then burst' plan converts worse the lower she gets, and that only the swap INTO Mercury Cannon applies the resist shred. Neither fact needed asserting on Poppy's page, but they are the reason this lane's win rate sits at 56.63% despite Jayce owning three of seven chart rows — worth keeping in mind if anyone revisits the difficulty rating. The weapon-swap R has no meaningful cooldown to track at 6 seconds; I stated that rather than telling the player to wait for it.
